desc:
⚠️ HEISTBLOX is in early development. Join the group to report bugs & share feedback!

💥HEISTBLOX is a unique Cops VS Robbers PVP shooter where Criminals must complete various heists while engaging in shootouts with Police players.

💰CRIMINALS - Rob the Bank, grab the loot and escape before the law catches up to you.
👤CIVILIANS - Run the clock down by completing tasks. Every task you finish brings the Police Response closer.
🚓POLICE - Once the timer reaches 0, Civilians & Spectators deploy as SWAT & a shootout begins.

⚙️FEATURES
🛠️Gadgets: Drones, Alarms, Breaching Charges, & more.
💣Grenades: Volumetric Smoke grenades that can be punched through with bullets, Incendiary Grenades that realistically flood a room, & more.
📱Playable on PC, mobile, & console.

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to support development!
